thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've got a repeating 'capacity choreography' problem: short midday spikes + end-of-day flushes trigger autoscale jitter and drain GPU headroom. Proposing a 5-day sprint of short fixes: a spread-spectrum quota soak, a conservative scheduler canary, and a daytime smoke monitor. Owners + targets below, pls ack and call blockers.

igor: I'll run the quota soak (RW-5301). Idea: staggered soft bumps (+8%, +12% on alternate days) to see sensitivity without a single big change. Proposed window 2027-01-10 -> 2027-01-14. Filing request and adding automated rollback.

sana: I'll own the scheduler canary (RW-5302). Plan: conservative changes only — add soft rate limit and reduce burst_window to 28s. Staging patch example: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"burst_window":"28s","burst_rate_limit_ms":"220"}}'` Canary 48h, with a revert script ready.

owen: I'll add the daytime smoke job + alerting (RW-5303). Smoke job path: `.github/workflows/daytime-headroom-smoke.yml` and alert: headroom_percent < 13% for any 5m during 09:00-19:00 PT. Pager links to runbook and quick-revert commands. Gate by `feature.headroom_smoke`.

runbook-bot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2259999999 and created follow-ups RW-5301, RW-5302, RW-5303.

maya: Consolidated owners & short targets: igor -> RW-5301 (quota soak) target 2027-01-18; sana -> RW-5302 (scheduler canary) target 2027-01-15; owen -> RW-5303 (smoke + alerts) target 2027-01-13. I'll run 10-min async check-ins Mon/Wed/Fri until these are closed. Next sync 2027-01-11 08:30 PT.

igor: Metrics I'll capture during staggered soak: `gpu_alloc_rate_1m`, `headroom_percent_p10`, `scale_up_frequency`, `slot_evictions`. Will output CSVs to RW-5301.

sana: Canary metrics: `preempt_count`, `tail_latency_ms_p99`, `queued_batches_p99`. Rollback conditions: preempt_count up >20% or tail_latency_p99 degraded >15%. Revert command included in RW-5302.

owen: Smoke job will generate daily snapshots and post them to `/dashboards/headroom/snapshots/2260012345.json`. Pager runbook includes steps to mute and rollback.

maya: Two quick asks: 1) cloud-ops please prioritize temporary quota approvals for the soak window, 2) platform SRE please keep paging conservative — we'll only page on severe SLA breaches during tests. Ping me for RBAC or cloud blockers.

igor: Pinged cloud-ops and added automated revert in the request.

sana: Scheduling canary for staging after igor's soak starts; will only roll forward after smoke checks pass.

owen: Adding smoke workflow PR now. Will gate by feature flag to disable if noisy.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the postmortem with owners, attach this thread, and mark these as P1 follow-ups. Acks?

igor: Ack.

sana: Ack.

owen: Ack :thumbsup:\"
